seriesArc: A connected mystery series built around Forensics, Interrogation, Timeline, and Deduction.
subtitle: A Live Detective Mystery Experience
title: Margaritas and Murder
description: A medium-difficulty restaurant mystery where deleted footage, sponsor money, and a corridor meeting unravel a dangerous cover-up.
lobbyBackstory: What should have been a packed margarita night at the restaurant becomes a homicide scene. Investigators recovered phones, corridor footage, a manager laptop, bank records, and vendor files.
rsvpExcerpt: Deleted footage and a hidden money trail sour a night of margaritas.
openingNarration: The sponsor reveal became a crime scene. Forensics has phones, bank records, video exports, and documents. Test every explanation against the verified timeline.
revealScript: Owen arranged the corridor meeting, altered the export, and hid the private vendor payment.

answerKey.method: He lured Lena to the corridor, created a security gap, and used a private vendor payment to hide sponsor funds.
answerKey.motive: Lena discovered sponsor money routed through a private vendor label connected to Owen’s office computer.
answerKey.keyEvidence: Corridor phone pings, missing security minutes, metadata from Owen’s manager login, and the private vendor payout.
answerKey.explanation: Owen’s statement fails against the pings, export metadata, and vendor trail.

forensics.title: Lena’s Last Message
forensics.text: Lena texted Owen, “We need to talk before the sponsor reveal.”

forensics.title: Two Phones in Patio Corridor
forensics.text: Lena’s phone and Owen’s phone both pinged near the patio corridor.

forensics.title: Corridor Footage Gap
forensics.text: The security export skips the exact two-minute corridor window.

forensics.title: Manager Login on Export
forensics.text: The corrupted video export was created under Owen’s manager login.

forensics.title: Private Vendor Payout
forensics.text: A sponsor deposit was duplicated under a private vendor label.

forensics.title: Vendor File on Office Computer
forensics.text: The private vendor invoice template was opened on Owen’s office computer.

forensics.title: Metadata Removal Search
forensics.text: Browser history shows searches about removing metadata from exported security clips.

forensics.title: Hallway Reflection Still
forensics.text: A reflection in the corridor glass shows Owen’s jacket during the missing footage window.

forensics.title: Keycard Scuff at Office Reader
forensics.text: The office keycard reader logged a fresh scrape matching Owen’s card sleeve.

forensics.title: Export Deleted and Recreated
forensics.text: The original corridor export was deleted and recreated seven minutes later from Owen’s account.

interrogation.title: Owen Landry
interrogation.text: Owen says Lena asked to meet, but he never made it to the corridor.

interrogation.title: Nia Cole
interrogation.text: Nia says Owen walked toward the patio corridor after checking his phone.

interrogation.title: Jules Mercer
interrogation.text: Jules says only managers had rights to export and replace corridor footage.

interrogation.title: Rae Fontenot
interrogation.text: Rae says Owen argued with Lena about sponsor numbers before the reveal.

interrogation.title: Owen Follow-Up
interrogation.text: Owen says the private vendor file was probably an old template, but cannot explain why it opened after the corridor gap.

timeline.text: Lena texts Owen about the sponsor reveal.

timeline.title: Phones Enter Corridor Zone

timeline.title: Owen Login Creates Export

timeline.title: Private Vendor Payout Posts

timeline.title: Original Export Deleted
timeline.text: Audit records show the original corridor export was deleted and recreated.
